### KB HOME NAMES CASEY DARE AS PRESIDENT OF ITS TAMPA DIVISION


August 28, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/462588783/files/doc_news/KB-HOME-NAMES-CASEY-DARE-AS-PRESIDENT-OF-ITS-TAMPA-DIVISION-2026.pdf)


**National homebuilder taps company veteran to lead its Tampa-area operations.**


TAMPA, Fla.


, Aug. 28, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- KB Home (NYSE: KBH) today announced that Casey Dare has been named as its Tampa Division President. In this role, Dare is responsible for the company's homebuilding operations throughout the region, from land acquisition and construction to sales and customer service.


Dare brings more than 20 years of homebuilding experience and 10 years of service with KB Home. He has served many roles with the company, including superintendent, customer service manager, director of customer service and operations, senior vice president of operations, and most recently, executive vice president for the Orlando division. He holds a bachelor's degree in psychology from Middle Tennessee State University and a Master of Business Administration from Georgia Southern University. Dare also served as an active-duty officer in the United States Army for 8 years.


"Casey brings an exceptional depth and breadth of experience to our Tampa division, executing on KB Home's distinctive customer-centric business model," said Vince DePorre, KB Home's East Region President. "We are excited to have him extend his outstanding career at KB Home by leading the strategic growth of our Tampa operations."


KB Home has been building in the Tampa region since 2002 and continues to expand its presence across the market. Most recently, the company plans to open four new single-family home communities this year: Morningside, Woodland Oaks, Deer Springs and Meade Estates. For more information about KB Home neighborhoods throughout the Tampa region, visit[www.kbhome.com](https://www.kbhome.com/) or call 888-KB-HOMES.


**About KB Home** KB Home is one of the largest and most trusted homebuilders in the U.S. We operate in 50 markets, have built over 700,000 quality homes in our nearly 70-year history, and are honored to be one of the top customer-ranked national homebuilders based on third-party buyer surveys. What sets KB Home apart is building strong, personal relationships with every customer and creating an exceptional experience that offers our homebuyers the ability to personalize their home based on what they value at a price they can afford. As the industry leader in sustainability, KB Home has achieved one of the highest residential energy-efficiency ratings and delivered more ENERGY STAR® certified homes than any other builder, helping to lower the total cost of homeownership. For more information, visit kbhome.com.
